main.name: Konrad Burchardt
main.bio:
I'm a Growth Marketer and Technical SEO professional with over 10 years of experience helping global brands scale their organic acquisition and conversion. At Figma, I lead Technical SEO, Programmatic SEO, and scalable landing page generation, developing AI-driven workflows and systems that reach users organically and support the company's growth strategy.

Previously, I worked at Realtor.com, Uber, ESPN, and The Walt Disney Company, where I focused on large-scale SEO initiatives, technical performance, and data-driven optimization. I also co-founded kwrds.ai, an AI-powered keyword research and content automation platform serving 500+ monthly users.

My current focus is on technical SEO, scalable automation, and growth experimentation. Using strategy, data, and creativity to build systems that drive long-term impact.

work.title: Growth Marketing Engineer, SEO
work.description: Own how Figma's content and site architecture perform across traditional and AI-driven search — engineering relevance at scale rather than managing crawl health alone. Lead GEO and AEO technical strategy, including how AI crawlers access and interpret Figma properties, and build structured experiments to improve how Figma is retrieved and cited across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. Design and ship internal automation: SEO audit workflows, research pipelines, content QA, and agentic systems that reduce manual overhead on repeatable processes, working within a cross-functional AI systems pod alongside marketing ops and growth engineering.

work.title: Growth Marketing Manager
work.description: Drove ~1,050% YoY signup growth by launching and scaling product-led, user-facing tools with Product, Design, and Engineering. Built AI-driven workflows and internal tooling to scale programmatic SEO, automation, and internationalization, generating 317K incremental organic clicks in 12 months. Owned product strategy and execution for Technical SEO, Programmatic SEO, and growth initiatives across Figma's acquisition surfaces, leading cross-functional teams to define requirements, prioritize roadmaps, and build optimized landing pages.

Contributed to achieving the #1 SEO ranking across the top 100 U.S. cities.
